name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.dual_output
statement:
theorem dual_output (i j : Var) :
    bracketK K (dualHamiltonian K i) (outputK K j) = if i=j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [dualHamiltonian,bracket_neg_left,bracketK_outputK_outputK,canonicalMatrixK,canonicalMatrix]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.dual_dual

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.delta_commute
statement: theorem delta_commute (i j : Var) : delta K i * delta K j = delta K j * delta K i
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [delta,delta,hamiltonian_commutator,dual_dual,hamiltonian_constant]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.delta_output
statement:
theorem delta_output (i j : Var) :
    delta K i * polynomial K (outputK K j) =
      polynomial K (outputK K j) * delta K i + if i=j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hamiltonian_polynomial K (dualHamiltonian K i) (outputK K j)
  rw [dual_output] at h
  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp
  by_cases he : i=j <;> simpa [delta,he] using h

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.dual_intertwining
statement:
theorem dual_intertwining (i : Var) (f : Poly K) :
    bracketK K (dualHamiltonian K i) (PhiK K f) = PhiK K (MvPolynomial.pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : dualHamiltonian K i = PhiK K (![MvPolynomial.X 2,MvPolynomial.X 3,
      -MvPolynomial.X 0,-MvPolynomial.X 1] i) := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp [dualHamiltonian]
  rw [hd,PhiK_isPoisson]
  congr 1
  fin_cases i <;> simp [bracketK,polyDerivK]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_intertwining_free
statement:
theorem representation_intertwining_free (a : Free K) (f : Poly K) :
    representation K (endomorphism K (quotient K a)) (PhiK K f) =
      PhiK K (representation K (quotient K a) f)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using FreeAlgebra.induction generalizing f with
  | grade0 c =>
    simp only [AlgHom.commutes]
    simp
  | grade1 v =>
    cases v with
    | inl i =>
      change representation K (endomorphism K (X K i)) (PhiK K f) =
        PhiK K (representation K (X K i) f)
      simp [representation_polynomial,multiplication_apply]
    | inr i =>
      change representation K (endomorphism K (deriv K i)) (PhiK K f) =
        PhiK K (representation K (deriv K i) f)
      simp only [endomorphism_deriv,delta,representation_hamiltonian,
        representation_deriv,differential_apply,dual_intertwining]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_add,LinearMap.add_apply,ha,hb]
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    simp only [map_mul,Module.End.mul_apply,hb,ha]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_intertwining
statement:
theorem representation_intertwining (a : Algebra K) (f : Poly K) :
    representation K (endomorphism K a) (PhiK K f) =
      PhiK K (representation K a f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_surjective K (Relation K) a
  exact representation_intertwining_free K a f

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.endomorphism_not_surjective
statement: theorem endomorphism_not_surjective : ¬Function.Surjective (endomorphism K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  apply HigherRank.base_not_surjective K
  intro g
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hs (polynomial K g)
  refine ⟨representation K a 1, ?_⟩
  have h := representation_intertwining K a 1
  rw [ha,representation_polynomial] at h
  simpa [multiplication_apply] using h.symm

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.hamiltonian_neg
statement: theorem hamiltonian_neg (f : Poly K) : hamiltonian K (-f) = -hamiltonian K f
proof:
:= by
  have hh : hCoefficients K (-f) = fun i => -hCoefficients K f i := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hCoefficients]
  simp only [hamiltonian,hh,vectorField]
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (congrArg (fun w : Algebra K => w * deriv K i)
    ((polynomial K).map_neg (hCoefficients K f i))).trans
      (neg_mul (polynomial K (hCoefficients K f i)) (deriv K i))

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.endomorphism_polynomial

    endomorphism K (polynomial K f) = polynomial K (PhiK K f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (endomorphism K).comp (polynomial K) = (polynomial K).comp (PhiK K) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    simp
  exact congrArg (fun e : Poly K →ₐ[K] Algebra K => e f) h

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.endomorphism_not_automorphism

    ¬∃ e : Algebra K ≃ₐ[K] Algebra K, e.toAlgHom = endomorphism K
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e,he⟩
  apply endomorphism_not_surjective K
  rw [← he]
  exact e.surjective

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.explicit_counterexample
statement:
theorem explicit_counterexample :
    (∀ i, endomorphism K (X K i) = polynomial K (outputK K i)) ∧
    (∀ i, endomorphism K (deriv K i) = delta K i) ∧
    ¬Function.Surjective (endomorphism K) ∧
    ¬∃ e : Algebra K ≃ₐ[K] Algebra K, e.toAlgHom = endomorphism K
proof:
:=
  ⟨endomorphism_X K,endomorphism_deriv K,endomorphism_not_surjective K,
    endomorphism_not_automorphism K⟩

    ¬∃ e : Algebra ℂ ≃ₐ[ℂ] Algebra ℂ, e.toAlgHom = endomorphism ℂ
proof:

  explicit_counterexample ℂ

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.core_fiber
statement:
theorem core_fiber (x y b : K) :
    (rValue x y b = 0 ∧ tValue x y b = 1 / 8 ∧ sValue x y b = 0) ↔
    (x = 0 ∧ y = 0 ∧ b =  -1 / 4) ∨
    (x = 1 ∧ y =  -3 / 2 ∧ b = 13 / 2) ∨
    (x =  -1 ∧ y = 3 / 2 ∧ b = 13 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, ht, hs⟩
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · subst x
      have hy : y = 0 := by simpa [sValue] using hs
      subst y
      left
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
      dsimp [tValue] at ht
      linear_combination -2 * ht
    · have hprod : x * (2 - 3 * x * y - x ^ 2 * b) = 0 := by
        dsimp [rValue] at hr
        linear_combination hr
      have ha : 2 - 3 * x * y - x ^ 2 * b = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left hx
      have hu : x * y = -3 / 2 := by
        dsimp [sValue] at hs
        linear_combination (1 / 4 : K) * (x * hs + 3 * (1 + x * y) ^ 2 * ha)
      have hb : x ^ 2 * b = 13 / 2 := by
        linear_combination -ha - 3 * hu
      have hx2 : x ^ 2 = 1 := by
        dsimp [tValue] at ht
        linear_combination -8 * x ^ 2 * ht - 4 * (1 + x * y) ^ 3 * hb -
          (12 * (x * y) ^ 3 + 36 * (x * y) ^ 2 + 40 * x * y + 18) * hu
      have hprod : (x - 1) * (x + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination hx2
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hp | hm
      · have hx1 : x = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp hp
        subst x
        right; left
        exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using hu, by simpa using hb⟩
      · have hx1 : x =  -1 := by linear_combination hm
        subst x
        right; right
        refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
        · linear_combination -hu
        · simpa using hb
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩) <;>
      norm_num [rValue, sValue, tValue]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.source_injective
statement:
theorem source_injective (v w : Var → K)
    (hx : v 0 = w 0) (hy : ev v y = ev w y)
    (hb : ev v beta = ev w beta) (hd : ev v D = ev w D) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  have hq : v 1 = w 1 := by
    rw [← recover_q v, ← recover_q w, hx, hy, hb]
  have hh : ev v H = ev w H := by rw [eval_h, eval_h, hx, hy, hb]
  have hd0 : ev v D0 = ev w D0 := by
    have h : ev v D0 + ev v H = ev w D0 + ev w H := by simpa [ev, D] using hd
    rw [hh] at h
    exact add_right_cancel h
  have hp : v 2 = w 2 := by
    rw [← recover_p v, ← recover_p w, hx, hq, hb, hd0]
  have hz : v 3 = w 3 := by
    rw [← recover_z v, ← recover_z w, hx, hq, hb, hd0]
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hx
  · exact hq
  · exact hp
  · exact hz

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.exact_fiber_charZero
statement:
theorem exact_fiber_charZero (v : Var → K) :
    pointMapK K (PhiK K) v = targetK K ↔
    v = point0K K ∨ v = point1K K ∨ v = fieldPoint K point2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨hr, ht, hd, hs⟩ := target_coordinates hv
    rw [eval_r] at hr
    rw [eval_t] at ht
    rw [eval_s] at hs
    rcases (core_fiber (v 0) (ev v y) (ev v beta)).mp ⟨hr, ht, hs⟩ with
      h0 | h1 | h2
    · left
      obtain ⟨hx, hy, hb⟩ := h0
      apply source_injective v (point0K K)
      · simpa [point0K, fieldPoint, point0] using hx
      · rw [hy]; norm_num [ev, point0K, fieldPoint, point0, y, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      · rw [hb]; norm_num [ev, point0K, fieldPoint, point0, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      · exact hd.trans (target_coordinates (point0K_image K)).2.2.1.symm
    · right; left
      obtain ⟨hx, hy, hb⟩ := h1
      apply source_injective v (point1K K)
      · simpa [point1K, fieldPoint, point1] using hx
      · rw [hy]; norm_num [ev, point1K, fieldPoint, point1, y, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      · rw [hb]; norm_num [ev, point1K, fieldPoint, point1, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      · exact hd.trans (target_coordinates (point1K_image K)).2.2.1.symm
    · right; right
      obtain ⟨hx, hy, hb⟩ := h2
      apply source_injective v (fieldPoint K point2)
      · simpa [fieldPoint, point2] using hx
      · rw [hy]; norm_num [ev, fieldPoint, point2, y, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      · rw [hb]; norm_num [ev, fieldPoint, point2, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
      · exact hd.trans (target_coordinates (point2K_image (K:=K))).2.2.1.symm
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact point0K_image K
    · exact point1K_image K
    · exact point2K_image

statement:

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.exact_fiber_rational
statement:
theorem exact_fiber_rational (v : Var → ℚ) :
    pointMap Phi v = target ↔ v = point0 ∨ v = point1 ∨ v = point2
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : pointMapK ℚ (PhiK ℚ) v = pointMap Phi v := by
    funext i
    rw [pointMap_eq]
    simp [ev, pointMap, Phi, MvPolynomial.aeval_eq_eval]
    change MvPolynomial.eval₂ _ v (output i) = MvPolynomial.eval₂ _ v (output i)
    congr 1
  have hfield (w : Var → ℚ) : fieldPoint ℚ w = w := by
    funext i
    simp [fieldPoint]
  have h := exact_fiber_charZero v
  rw [hmap, targetK, point0K, point1K, hfield, hfield, hfield, hfield] at h
  exact h

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.fiber_points_distinct
statement:
theorem fiber_points_distinct :
    point0K K ≠ point1K K ∧ point0K K ≠ fieldPoint K point2 ∧
    point1K K ≠ fieldPoint K point2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨point0K_ne_point1K K, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h 0
    norm_num [point0K, fieldPoint, point0, point2] at h0
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h 0
    norm_num [point1K, fieldPoint, point1, point2] at h0

name: RankTwoPoisson.Fiber.localized_core
statement:
theorem localized_core (x y b : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    let w := 1 + x * y
    let a := 2 - 3 * x * y - x ^ 2 * b
    rValue x y b = x * a ∧
    sValue x y b = (2 + 4 * w - 3 * a * w ^ 2) / x ∧
    tValue x y b = (a * w ^ 3 - w ^ 2 - w) / (2 * x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [rValue, sValue, tValue]
  constructor
  · ring
  constructor <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.SourceCoordinates.inverse_source
statement: theorem inverse_source : inverseHom.comp sourceHom = AlgHom.id ℚ P
proof:

  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext

  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, sourceHom, inverseHom, aeval_X, AlgHom.id_apply]
  fin_cases i
  · simp [sourceTuple, inverseTuple, x]
  · change aeval inverseTuple y = q
    convert yBack_eq using 1
    simp [yBack, betaBack, y, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, inverseTuple]
    apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v
    simp only [map_ofNat]
  · change aeval inverseTuple beta = p
    convert betaBack_eq using 1
    simp [betaBack, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z, inverseTuple]
    apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v

  · change aeval inverseTuple D0 = z

    apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v

name: RankTwoPoisson.SourceCoordinates.substitution_map

  | C c => simp [mapK]

statement:
theorem expanded_coefficients :
    (wedgeCoeff r h 0 1 + wedgeCoeff t s 0 1 =
      crat (1/2)*(Xc*Wc+3*Yc)*(7*Xc^2*Wc^2+42*Xc*Yc*Wc+3*Wc+63*Yc^2)) ∧
    (wedgeCoeff r h 0 2 + wedgeCoeff t s 0 2 =
      crat (1/6)*(7*Xc^4*Wc^3+63*Xc^3*Yc*Wc^2+6*Xc^2*Wc^2+
        189*Xc^2*Yc^2*Wc+24*Xc*Yc*Wc+Wc+189*Xc*Yc^3+18*Yc^2)) ∧
    (wedgeCoeff r h 1 2 + wedgeCoeff t s 1 2 = crat (1/2)*(Xc^2*Wc+3*Xc*Yc+1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficient_identity.1, coefficient_identity.2.1, coefficient_identity.2.2]
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩ <;> apply MvPolynomial.funext <;> intro v <;>
    simp [A1,A2,A3,Q3,crat,Xc,Yc,Wc] <;> ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.X_commute
statement: theorem X_commute (i j : Var) : X K i * X K j = X K j * X K i
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [X,quotient,← map_mul] using RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel K (Relation.xx (K:=K) i j)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.deriv_commute
statement: theorem deriv_commute (i j : Var) : deriv K i * deriv K j = deriv K j * deriv K i
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [deriv,quotient,← map_mul] using RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel K (Relation.dd (K:=K) i j)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.deriv_X
statement: theorem deriv_X (i j : Var) : deriv K i * X K j = X K j * deriv K i + if i=j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := RingQuot.mkAlgHom_rel K (Relation.dx (K:=K) i j)
  simpa [X,deriv,quotient,map_mul,map_add,apply_ite] using h

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.lift_X
statement:
theorem lift_X (F D : Var → A) (hxx hdd hdx) (i : Var) :
    lift K F D hxx hdd hdx (X K i) = F i
proof:
:= by
  rw [X,quotient,lift,RingQuot.liftAlgHom_mkAlgHom_apply]
  simp [freeX]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.lift_deriv
statement:
theorem lift_deriv (F D : Var → A) (hxx hdd hdx) (i : Var) :
    lift K F D hxx hdd hdx (deriv K i) = D i
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv,quotient,lift,RingQuot.liftAlgHom_mkAlgHom_apply]
  simp [freeD]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext (f g : Algebra K →ₐ[K] A)
    (hx : ∀ i, f (X K i) = g (X K i))
    (hd : ∀ i, f (deriv K i) = g (deriv K i)) : f=g
proof:
:= by
  apply RingQuot.ringQuot_ext'
  apply FreeAlgebra.hom_ext
  funext i
  cases i with
  | inl i => exact hx i
  | inr i => exact hd i

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.polynomial_X
statement: @[simp] theorem polynomial_X (i : Var) : polynomial K (MvPolynomial.X i) = X K i
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomial]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.polynomial_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomial_C (c : K) :
    polynomial K (MvPolynomial.C c) = algebraMap K (Algebra K) c
proof:
:= by
  exact (polynomial K).commutes c

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.polynomial_commute
statement:
theorem polynomial_commute (f g : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    polynomial K f * polynomial K g = polynomial K g * polynomial K f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_mul,← map_mul,mul_comm]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.deriv_polynomial
statement:
theorem deriv_polynomial (i : Var) (f : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    deriv K i * polynomial K f = polynomial K f * deriv K i + polynomial K (MvPolynomial.pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c =>
    simp only [MvPolynomial.pderiv_C,map_zero,add_zero]
    rw [polynomial_C]
    exact (_root_.Algebra.commutes c (deriv K i)).symm
  | add f g hf hg =>
    simp only [map_add,mul_add,add_mul,hf,hg]
    abel
  | mul_X f j hf =>
    simp only [map_mul,polynomial_X,MvPolynomial.pderiv_mul,map_add]
    rw [← mul_assoc,hf,add_mul,mul_assoc,deriv_X]
    by_cases h : i=j <;> simp [MvPolynomial.pderiv_X,h] <;> noncomm_ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.multiplication_apply
statement: theorem multiplication_apply (f g : Poly K) : multiplication K f g = f*g
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.differential_apply
statement: theorem differential_apply (i : Var) (f : Poly K) : differential K i f = MvPolynomial.pderiv i f
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.operator_xx
statement:
theorem operator_xx (i j : Var) :
    multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X i) * multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X j) =
      multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X j) * multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_mul,← map_mul,mul_comm]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.operator_dd
statement: theorem operator_dd (i j : Var) : differential K i * differential K j = differential K j * differential K i
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  exact Calculus.pderiv_comm i j f

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.operator_dx
statement:
theorem operator_dx (i j : Var) :
    differential K i * multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X j) =
      multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X j) * differential K i + if i=j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  by_cases h : i=j <;>
    simp [Module.End.mul_apply,LinearMap.add_apply,multiplication_apply,differential_apply,
      MvPolynomial.pderiv_X,h]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem representation_X (i : Var) :
    representation K (X K i) = multiplication K (MvPolynomial.X i)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_deriv
statement:
@[simp] theorem representation_deriv (i : Var) :
    representation K (deriv K i) = differential K i
proof: := lift_deriv _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_polynomial
statement:
theorem representation_polynomial (f : Poly K) :
    representation K (polynomial K f) = multiplication K f
proof:
:= by
  have he : (representation K).comp (polynomial K) = multiplication K := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    simp
  exact congrArg (fun e : Poly K →ₐ[K] Module.End K (Poly K) => e f) he

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.polynomial_injective
statement: theorem polynomial_injective : Function.Injective (polynomial K)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  have he := congrArg (representation K) h
  rw [representation_polynomial,representation_polynomial] at he
  exact _root_.Algebra.lmul_injective he

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.firstOrder_product
statement:
theorem firstOrder_product (a b : Poly K) (i j : Var) :
    (polynomial K a * deriv K i) * (polynomial K b * deriv K j) =
      polynomial K (a*b) * (deriv K i * deriv K j) +
      polynomial K (a*MvPolynomial.pderiv i b) * deriv K j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = polynomial K a * (deriv K i * polynomial K b) * deriv K j := by noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [deriv_polynomial]
      simp only [map_mul]
      noncomm_ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.firstOrder_commutator
statement:
theorem firstOrder_commutator (a b : Poly K) (i j : Var) :
    (polynomial K a * deriv K i) * (polynomial K b * deriv K j) -
      (polynomial K b * deriv K j) * (polynomial K a * deriv K i) =
      polynomial K (a*MvPolynomial.pderiv i b) * deriv K j -
      polynomial K (b*MvPolynomial.pderiv j a) * deriv K i
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstOrder_product,firstOrder_product,mul_comm b a,deriv_commute K j i]
  abel

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.vectorField_commutator
statement:
theorem vectorField_commutator (a b : Var → Poly K) :
    vectorField K a * vectorField K b - vectorField K b * vectorField K a =
      vectorField K (vectorBracket K a b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold vectorField vectorBracket
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => (polynomial K (b j) * deriv K j) * (polynomial K (a i) * deriv K i))]
  simp only [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,firstOrder_commutator]
  simp only [map_sum,map_sub,sub_mul,Finset.sum_mul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact congrArg₂ (· - ·) rfl (Finset.sum_comm)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.vectorBracket_hCoefficients
statement:
theorem vectorBracket_hCoefficients (f g : Poly K) :
    vectorBracket K (hCoefficients K f) (hCoefficients K g) = hCoefficients K (bracketK K f g)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [vectorBracket,hCoefficients,Fin.sum_univ_succ,bracketK,polyDerivK] <;>
    simp only [Calculus.pderiv_comm (1 : Var) 0, Calculus.pderiv_comm (2 : Var) 0,
      Calculus.pderiv_comm (3 : Var) 0, Calculus.pderiv_comm (2 : Var) 1,
      Calculus.pderiv_comm (3 : Var) 1, Calculus.pderiv_comm (3 : Var) 2] <;> ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.hamiltonian_commutator
statement:
theorem hamiltonian_commutator (f g : Poly K) :
    hamiltonian K f * hamiltonian K g - hamiltonian K g * hamiltonian K f =
      hamiltonian K (bracketK K f g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hamiltonian,hamiltonian,vectorField_commutator,vectorBracket_hCoefficients]
  rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.hamiltonian_constant
statement: theorem hamiltonian_constant (c : K) : hamiltonian K (MvPolynomial.C c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [hamiltonian,vectorField,hCoefficients,Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.vectorField_polynomial
statement:
theorem vectorField_polynomial (a : Var → Poly K) (f : Poly K) :
    vectorField K a * polynomial K f - polynomial K f * vectorField K a =
      polynomial K (∑ i, a i * MvPolynomial.pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold vectorField
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  calc
    _ = polynomial K (a i) * (deriv K i * polynomial K f) -
        (polynomial K f * polynomial K (a i)) * deriv K i := by noncomm_ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [deriv_polynomial,polynomial_commute K f (a i)]
      simp only [map_mul]
      noncomm_ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.hamiltonian_polynomial
statement:
theorem hamiltonian_polynomial (f g : Poly K) :
    hamiltonian K f * polynomial K g - polynomial K g * hamiltonian K f =
      polynomial K (bracketK K f g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hamiltonian,vectorField_polynomial]
  congr 1
  simp [hCoefficients,Fin.sum_univ_succ,bracketK,polyDerivK]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_vectorField
statement:
theorem representation_vectorField (a : Var → Poly K) (f : Poly K) :
    representation K (vectorField K a) f = ∑ i, a i * MvPolynomial.pderiv i f
proof:
:= by
  simp [vectorField,map_sum,LinearMap.sum_apply,Module.End.mul_apply,
    representation_polynomial,differential_apply,multiplication_apply]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Weyl.representation_hamiltonian
statement:
theorem representation_hamiltonian (f g : Poly K) :
    representation K (hamiltonian K f) g = bracketK K f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [hamiltonian,representation_vectorField]
  simp [hCoefficients,Fin.sum_univ_succ,bracketK,polyDerivK]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.pair_add_left
statement:
theorem pair_add_left (f g h : Poly m K) (u v) :
    pairTerm m K (f+g) h u v = pairTerm m K f h u v + pairTerm m K g h u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairTerm]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.pair_add_right
statement:
theorem pair_add_right (f g h : Poly m K) (u v) :
    pairTerm m K f (g+h) u v = pairTerm m K f g u v + pairTerm m K f h u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairTerm]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.pair_mul_left
statement:
theorem pair_mul_left (f g h : Poly m K) (u v) :
    pairTerm m K (f*g) h u v = f*pairTerm m K g h u v + g*pairTerm m K f h u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairTerm]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.pair_mul_right
statement:
theorem pair_mul_right (f g h : Poly m K) (u v) :
    pairTerm m K f (g*h) u v = g*pairTerm m K f h u v + h*pairTerm m K f g u v
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairTerm]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.add_left
statement: theorem add_left (f g h : Poly m K) : bracket m K (f+g) h = bracket m K f h + bracket m K g h
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket,pair_add_left,Finset.sum_add_distrib]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.add_right
statement: theorem add_right (f g h : Poly m K) : bracket m K f (g+h) = bracket m K f g + bracket m K f h
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket,pair_add_right,Finset.sum_add_distrib]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.mul_left
statement: theorem mul_left (f g h : Poly m K) : bracket m K (f*g) h = f*bracket m K g h + g*bracket m K f h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bracket,pair_mul_left,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.mul_right
statement: theorem mul_right (f g h : Poly m K) : bracket m K f (g*h) = g*bracket m K f h + h*bracket m K f g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bracket,pair_mul_right,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.C_left
statement: @[simp] theorem C_left (c : K) (f : Poly m K) : bracket m K (C c) f = 0
proof: := by simp [bracket,pairTerm]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.C_right
statement: @[simp] theorem C_right (f : Poly m K) (c : K) : bracket m K f (C c) = 0
proof: := by simp [bracket,pairTerm]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.lift_X
statement: @[simp] theorem lift_X (i : Var) : lift m K (X i) = X (.inl i)
proof: := rename_X _ _

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.deriv_lift_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem deriv_lift_inl (i : Var) (f : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    pderiv (.inl i) (lift m K f) = lift m K (pderiv i f)
proof:
:=
  pderiv_rename Sum.inl_injective i f

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.deriv_lift_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem deriv_lift_inr (i : Fin m × Fin 2) (f : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    pderiv (.inr i) (lift m K f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp [lift]
  | add f g hf hg => simp [hf,hg]
  | mul_X f j hf =>
    simp only [map_mul, lift_X, MvPolynomial.pderiv_mul, hf]
    simp

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.bracket_lift
statement:
theorem bracket_lift (f g : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    bracket m K (lift m K f) (lift m K g) = lift m K (bracketK K f g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket,pairTerm,bracketK,polyDerivK]; ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.bracket_lift_X
statement:
theorem bracket_lift_X (f : MvPolynomial Var K) (j : Fin m × Fin 2) :
    bracket m K (lift m K f) (X (.inr j)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket,pairTerm]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.bracket_X_lift
statement:
theorem bracket_X_lift (i : Fin m × Fin 2) (f : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    bracket m K (X (.inr i)) (lift m K f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracket,pairTerm]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.pointMap_of_surjective_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  have hc : (aeval v).comp φ = (aeval w).comp φ := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    exact congrFun h i
  funext i
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hs (X i)
  have hi := congrArg (fun e : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] K => e f) hc
  simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply,hf,aeval_X] using hi

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_X_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem Phi_X_inl (i : Var) : Phi m K (X (.inl i)) = lift m K (outputK K i)
proof: := by simp [Phi,output]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_X_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem Phi_X_inr (i : Fin m × Fin 2) : Phi m K (X (.inr i)) = X (.inr i)
proof: := by simp [Phi,output]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_lift
statement: theorem Phi_lift (f : MvPolynomial Var K) : Phi m K (lift m K f) = lift m K (PhiK K f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Phi m K).comp (lift m K) = (lift m K).comp (PhiK K) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro i
    simp [lift, PhiK_X]
  exact congrArg (fun e : MvPolynomial Var K →ₐ[K] Poly m K => e f) h

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_generators
statement:
theorem Phi_generators (i j : Vars m) :
    bracket m K (Phi m K (X i)) (Phi m K (X j)) = Phi m K (bracket m K (X i) (X j))
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | inl i =>
    cases j with
    | inl j =>
      rw [← lift_X m K i, ← lift_X m K j]
      rw [Phi_lift, Phi_lift, bracket_lift, bracket_lift, Phi_lift]
      exact congrArg (lift m K) (PhiK_isPoisson K (X i) (X j))
    | inr j =>
      rw [Phi_X_inl,Phi_X_inr,bracket_lift_X, ← lift_X m K i,bracket_lift_X,map_zero]
  | inr i =>
    cases j with
    | inl j =>
      rw [Phi_X_inr,Phi_X_inl,bracket_X_lift, ← lift_X m K j,bracket_X_lift,map_zero]
    | inr j =>
      simp only [Phi_X_inr,bracket,pairTerm,pderiv_X,Pi.single_apply,
        map_add,map_sub,map_mul,map_sum]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      split_ifs <;> simp

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_preserves
statement:
theorem Phi_preserves (f g : Poly m K) :
    bracket m K (Phi m K f) (Phi m K g) = Phi m K (bracket m K f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hg (i : Vars m) (f : Poly m K) :
      bracket m K (Phi m K f) (Phi m K (X i)) = Phi m K (bracket m K f (X i)) := by
    induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C c => simp [Phi]
    | add f g hf hg => simp only [map_add,add_left]; rw [hf,hg]
    | mul_X f j hf => simp only [map_mul,mul_left,map_add]; rw [Phi_generators,hf]
  induction g using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp [Phi]
  | add g h hg hh => simp only [map_add,add_right]; rw [hg,hh]
  | mul_X g j h => simp only [map_mul,mul_right,map_add]; rw [hg,h]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.pointMap_extendPoint
statement:
theorem pointMap_extendPoint (v : Var → K) :
    pointMap K (Phi m K) (extendPoint m K v) = extendPoint m K (pointMapK K (PhiK K) v)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  cases i <;>
    simp [pointMap,Phi,output,lift,extendPoint,pointMapK,PhiK,aeval_rename,Function.comp_def]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.extended_collision
statement:
theorem extended_collision :
    pointMap K (Phi m K) (extendPoint m K (point0K K)) =
      pointMap K (Phi m K) (extendPoint m K (point1K K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointMap_extendPoint,pointMap_extendPoint,point0K_image,point1K_image]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.extended_points_distinct
statement: theorem extended_points_distinct : extendPoint m K (point0K K) ≠ extendPoint m K (point1K K)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply point0K_ne_point1K K
  funext i
  exact congrFun h (.inl i)

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_not_surjective
statement: theorem Phi_not_surjective : ¬ Function.Surjective (Phi m K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  exact extended_points_distinct m K
    (pointMap_of_surjective_injective K (Phi m K) hs (extended_collision m K))

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.Phi_not_automorphism
statement:
theorem Phi_not_automorphism :
    ¬ ∃ e : Poly m K ≃ₐ[K] Poly m K, e.toAlgHom = Phi m K
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e,he⟩
  apply Phi_not_surjective m K
  rw [← he]
  exact e.surjective

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.base_not_surjective
statement: theorem base_not_surjective : ¬ Function.Surjective (PhiK K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  exact point0K_ne_point1K K (pointMap_of_surjective_injective K (PhiK K) hs
    ((point0K_image K).trans (point1K_image K).symm))

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.coordinate_zero
statement: theorem coordinate_zero : coordinateEquiv m (.inl 0) = (Fin.castAdd m 0,0)
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.coordinate_one
statement: theorem coordinate_one : coordinateEquiv m (.inl 1) = (Fin.castAdd m 1,0)
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.coordinate_two
statement: theorem coordinate_two : coordinateEquiv m (.inl 2) = (Fin.castAdd m 0,1)
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.coordinate_three
statement: theorem coordinate_three : coordinateEquiv m (.inl 3) = (Fin.castAdd m 1,1)
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.coordinate_extra
statement:
theorem coordinate_extra (i : Fin m × Fin 2) :
    coordinateEquiv m (.inr i) = (Fin.natAdd 2 i.1,i.2)
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.reindex_bracket
statement:
theorem reindex_bracket (f g : Poly m K) :
    canonicalBracket K (2+m) (rename (coordinateEquiv m) f) (rename (coordinateEquiv m) g) =
      rename (coordinateEquiv m) (bracket m K f g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalBracket
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin m ≃ Fin (2+m))]
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [finSumFinEquiv_apply_left,finSumFinEquiv_apply_right,Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [← coordinate_zero, ← coordinate_one, ← coordinate_two, ← coordinate_three]
  simp only [pderiv_rename (coordinateEquiv m).injective]
  have hextra (k : Fin m) (b : Fin 2) :
      pderiv (Fin.natAdd 2 k,b) (rename (coordinateEquiv m) f) =
        rename (coordinateEquiv m) (pderiv (.inr (k,b)) f) := by
    rw [← coordinate_extra m (k,b)]
    exact pderiv_rename (coordinateEquiv m).injective _ f
  have hextra' (k : Fin m) (b : Fin 2) :
      pderiv (Fin.natAdd 2 k,b) (rename (coordinateEquiv m) g) =
        rename (coordinateEquiv m) (pderiv (.inr (k,b)) g) := by
    rw [← coordinate_extra m (k,b)]
    exact pderiv_rename (coordinateEquiv m).injective _ g
  simp only [hextra,hextra',bracket,pairTerm,map_add,map_sub,map_mul,map_sum]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.reindexEquiv_bracket
statement:
theorem reindexEquiv_bracket (f g : Poly m K) :

proof: := reindex_bracket m K f g

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.standardPhi_reindex
statement:

proof:
:= by
  simp [standardPhi]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.standardPhi_preserves
statement:
theorem standardPhi_preserves (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin (2+m) × Fin 2) K) :
    canonicalBracket K (2+m) (standardPhi m K f) (standardPhi m K g) =
      standardPhi m K (canonicalBracket K (2+m) f g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f,rfl⟩ := (reindexEquiv m K).surjective f
  obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := (reindexEquiv m K).surjective g
  rw [standardPhi_reindex,standardPhi_reindex,reindexEquiv_bracket,
    reindexEquiv_bracket,standardPhi_reindex,Phi_preserves]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.standardPhi_not_surjective
statement: theorem standardPhi_not_surjective : ¬ Function.Surjective (standardPhi m K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  apply Phi_not_surjective m K
  intro f
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hs (reindexEquiv m K f)
  refine ⟨(reindexEquiv m K).symm g, (reindexEquiv m K).injective ?_⟩
  exact hg

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.standardPhi_not_automorphism
statement:
theorem standardPhi_not_automorphism :
    ¬ ∃ e : MvPolynomial (Fin (2+m) × Fin 2) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin (2+m) × Fin 2) K,
      e.toAlgHom = standardPhi m K
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e,he⟩
  apply standardPhi_not_surjective m K
  rw [← he]
  exact e.surjective

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.standardPhi_X
statement:
theorem standardPhi_X (i : Vars m) :
    standardPhi m K (X (coordinateEquiv m i)) = reindexEquiv m K (output m K i)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : reindexEquiv m K (X i) = X (coordinateEquiv m i) := by simp [reindexEquiv]
  rw [← hi,standardPhi_reindex]
  simp [Phi]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.standardPhi_X_extra

    standardPhi m K (X (Fin.natAdd 2 i,b)) = X (Fin.natAdd 2 i,b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinate_extra m (i,b),standardPhi_X]
  simp [output,reindexEquiv]

name: RankTwoPoisson.HigherRank.every_rank
statement:
theorem every_rank (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ φ : MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin 2) K,
      (∀ f g, canonicalBracket K n (φ f) (φ g) = φ (canonicalBracket K n f g)) ∧
      ¬ Function.Surjective φ ∧
      ¬ ∃ e : MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin 2) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin 2) K,
        e.toAlgHom = φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  exact ⟨standardPhi m K,standardPhi_preserves m K,
    standardPhi_not_surjective m K,standardPhi_not_automorphism m K⟩

name: RankTwoPoisson.PhiK_preserves_right_generator
statement:
lemma PhiK_preserves_right_generator
    (i : Var) (f : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    bracketK K (PhiK K f) (PhiK K (X i))
      = PhiK K (bracketK K f (X i))
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
    (motive := fun h : MvPolynomial Var K =>
      bracketK K (PhiK K h) (PhiK K (X i))
        = PhiK K (bracketK K h (X i)))
    f ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro c
    simp
  · intro f g hf hg
    simp only [map_add, bracketK_add_left]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hf hg
  · intro f j hf
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracketK_mul_left]
    rw [PhiK_generator_bracket, hf]

name: RankTwoPoisson.PhiK_isPoisson
statement: theorem PhiK_isPoisson : IsPoissonK K (PhiK K)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g
  refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
    (motive := fun h : MvPolynomial Var K =>
      bracketK K (PhiK K f) (PhiK K h) = PhiK K (bracketK K f h))
    g ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro c
    simp
  · intro g h hg hh
    simp only [map_add, bracketK_add_right]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hg hh
  · intro g j hg
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracketK_mul_right]
    rw [PhiK_preserves_right_generator, hg]

name: RankTwoPoisson.aeval_mapK_fieldPoint

theorem aeval_mapK_fieldPoint (v : Var → ℚ) (f : P) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fieldPoint K v) (mapK K f)
      = algebraMap ℚ K (MvPolynomial.aeval v f)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : fieldPoint K v = (algebraMap ℚ K) ∘ v := by
    funext i
    rfl
  rw [hpoint]

name: RankTwoPoisson.point0K_ne_point1K

proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrFun h 0
  have h01 : (0 : K) = 1 := by
    simpa [point0K, point1K, fieldPoint, point0, point1] using h0
  exact zero_ne_one h01

name: RankTwoPoisson.pointMapK_of_equiv_injective
statement:
theorem pointMapK_of_equiv_injective
    (e : MvPolynomial Var K ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial Var K) :
    Function.Injective (pointMapK K e.toAlgHom)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  funext i
  have hcomp :
      (MvPolynomial.aeval v).comp e.toAlgHom =
      (MvPolynomial.aeval w).comp e.toAlgHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro j
    simpa [pointMapK] using congrFun h j
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun φ : MvPolynomial Var K →ₐ[K] K => φ (e.symm (X i))) hcomp
  simpa using hi

name: RankTwoPoisson.PhiK_not_automorphism
statement: theorem PhiK_not_automorphism : ¬ IsAlgAutomorphismK K (PhiK K)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e, he⟩
  have hcollision :
      pointMapK K (PhiK K) (point0K K) = pointMapK K (PhiK K) (point1K K) :=
    (point0K_image K).trans (point1K_image K).symm
  have hcollision' :
      pointMapK K e.toAlgHom (point0K K) = pointMapK K e.toAlgHom (point1K K) := by
    simpa [he] using hcollision
  have hp : point0K K = point1K K :=
    pointMapK_of_equiv_injective K e hcollision'
  exact point0K_ne_point1K K hp

name: RankTwoPoisson.Core.core_det_rational
statement: theorem core_det_rational : jacobianMatrix.det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : jacobianMatrix.det = jac3 r t s := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp [jacobianMatrix, coreOutput, jac3, cpartial, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring
  rw [h, core_jacobian]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Core.core_det_charZero
statement:
theorem core_det_charZero (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] :
    Matrix.det (fun i j : CoreVar => MvPolynomial.pderiv j (coreOutputK K i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Matrix.det (fun i j : CoreVar => MvPolynomial.pderiv j (coreOutputK K i))
        = (jacobianMatrix.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ K))).det := by
            congr 1
            ext i j
            simp only [coreOutputK, Matrix.map_apply, jacobianMatrix,
              MvPolynomial.pderiv_map]
    _ = (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ K)) jacobianMatrix.det :=
          (RingHom.map_det _ _).symm
    _ = 1 := by rw [core_det_rational, map_one]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Core.coefficient_identity_matrix
statement:
theorem coefficient_identity_matrix (i j : CoreVar) :
    wedgeCoeff r h i j + wedgeCoeff t s i j = residualForm i j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h01,h02,h12⟩ := coefficient_identity
  have h10 : wedgeCoeff r h 1 0 + wedgeCoeff t s 1 0 = -A1 := by
    rw [wedge_skew r h 1 0, wedge_skew t s 1 0, ← neg_add, h01]
  have h20 : wedgeCoeff r h 2 0 + wedgeCoeff t s 2 0 = -A2 := by
    rw [wedge_skew r h 2 0, wedge_skew t s 2 0, ← neg_add, h02]
  have h21 : wedgeCoeff r h 2 1 + wedgeCoeff t s 2 1 = -A3 := by
    rw [wedge_skew r h 2 1, wedge_skew t s 2 1, ← neg_add, h12]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [residualForm, h01,h02,h12,h10,h20,h21]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Calculus.pderiv_comm
statement:
theorem pderiv_comm (i j : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    MvPolynomial.pderiv i (MvPolynomial.pderiv j f) =
    MvPolynomial.pderiv j (MvPolynomial.pderiv i f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⁅MvPolynomial.pderiv (R:=K) i, MvPolynomial.pderiv (R:=K) j⁆ = 0 := by
    apply MvPolynomial.derivation_ext
    intro k
    by_cases hi : i = k <;> by_cases hj : j = k <;>
      simp [Derivation.commutator_apply, MvPolynomial.pderiv_X, hi, hj]
  have hf := congrArg (fun D : Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K) (MvPolynomial σ K) => D f) h
  simpa [Derivation.commutator_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hf

name: RankTwoPoisson.Calculus.hamiltonian_identity
statement:
theorem hamiltonian_identity (f g h : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    bracketK K f (bracketK K g h) - bracketK K g (bracketK K f h) =
    bracketK K (bracketK K f g) h
proof:
:= by
  simp [bracketK, polyDerivK, pderiv_comm]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Calculus.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi (f g h : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    bracketK K f (bracketK K g h) + bracketK K g (bracketK K h f) +
      bracketK K h (bracketK K f g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hamiltonian_identity K f g h
  rw [Symplectic.bracket_skewK K h f, Symplectic.bracket_skewK K h (bracketK K f g)]
  have hn : bracketK K g (- bracketK K f h) = - bracketK K g (bracketK K f h) := by
    simp [bracketK, polyDerivK]
    ring
  rw [hn]
  linear_combination hi

name: RankTwoPoisson.Calculus.hamiltonian_commutator

proof:
:= by
  apply Derivation.ext
  intro h
  simpa only [Derivation.commutator_apply, hamiltonian_apply] using
    hamiltonian_identity K f g h

name: RankTwoPoisson.point0C_image

name: RankTwoPoisson.point1C_image

name: RankTwoPoisson.pointMapC_of_equiv_injective
statement:
theorem pointMapC_of_equiv_injective (e : PC ≃ₐ[ℂ] PC) :
    Function.Injective (pointMapC e.toAlgHom)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  funext i
  have hcomp :
      (MvPolynomial.aeval v).comp e.toAlgHom =
      (MvPolynomial.aeval w).comp e.toAlgHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro j
    simpa [pointMapC] using congrFun h j

name: RankTwoPoisson.PhiC_not_automorphism
statement: theorem PhiC_not_automorphism : ¬ IsAlgAutomorphismC PhiC
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e, he⟩
  have hcollision : pointMapC PhiC point0C = pointMapC PhiC point1C :=
    point0C_image.trans point1C_image.symm
  have hcollision' :
      pointMapC e.toAlgHom point0C = pointMapC e.toAlgHom point1C := by
    simpa [he] using hcollision
  have hp : point0C = point1C := pointMapC_of_equiv_injective e hcollision'
  exact point0C_ne_point1C hp

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.omega_mul_neg
statement: theorem omega_mul_neg : (omega : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) * (-omega) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [omega, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.neg_mul_omega
statement: theorem neg_mul_omega : -(omega : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) * omega = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_mul, ← Matrix.mul_neg, omega_mul_neg]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.conjugate_imp
statement:
theorem conjugate_imp (J U V : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A)
    (huv : U * V = 1) (hvu : V * U = 1) (h : J * V * J.transpose = V) :
    J.transpose * U * J = U
proof:
:= by
  have hr : J * (V * J.transpose * U) = 1 := by
    calc
      J * (V * J.transpose * U) = (J * V * J.transpose) * U := by simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = V * U := by rw [h]
      _ = 1 := hvu
  have hl : (V * J.transpose * U) * J = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hr
  calc
    J.transpose * U * J = U * ((V * J.transpose * U) * J) := by simp [← Matrix.mul_assoc, huv]
    _ = U := by rw [hl, Matrix.mul_one]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.conjugate_iff
statement:
theorem conjugate_iff (J U V : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A)
    (huv : U * V = 1) (hvu : V * U = 1) :
    J * V * J.transpose = V ↔ J.transpose * U * J = U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact conjugate_imp J U V huv hvu
  · intro h
    simpa only [transpose_transpose] using conjugate_imp J.transpose V U hvu huv h

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.bracket_matrix
statement:
theorem bracket_matrix (J : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) (i j : Fin 4) :
    (J * (-omega) * J.transpose : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) i j = pair (J i) (J j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, omega, pair]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.det_pair
statement:
theorem det_pair (J : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) :
    J.det = pair (J 2) (J 0) * pair (J 3) (J 1) -
      pair (J 0) (J 1) * pair (J 2) (J 3) +
      pair (J 0) (J 3) * pair (J 2) (J 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : Fin 4).succAbove (2 : Fin 3) = 3 := rfl
  have h2 : (2 : Fin 4).succAbove (2 : Fin 3) = 3 := rfl
  have h3 : (3 : Fin 4).succAbove (2 : Fin 3) = 2 := rfl
  simp [Matrix.det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Matrix.submatrix_apply, pair, h1, h2, h3]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.form_entry
statement:
theorem form_entry (J : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) (i j : Fin 4) :
    (J.transpose * omega * J : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) A) i j =
    J 0 i * J 2 j - J 2 i * J 0 j + J 1 i * J 3 j - J 3 i * J 1 j
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, omega]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.jacobian_pair
statement:
theorem jacobian_pair (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K) (i j : Var) :
    pair (jacobian K F i) (jacobian K F j) = bracketK K (F i) (F j)
proof: := rfl

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.preserves_of_generators
statement:
theorem preserves_of_generators (φ : MvPolynomial Var K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial Var K)
    (h : ∀ i j : Var, bracketK K (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) (φ (MvPolynomial.X j)) =
      φ (bracketK K (MvPolynomial.X i) (MvPolynomial.X j))) : IsPoissonK K φ
proof:
:= by
  have hright (i : Var) (f : MvPolynomial Var K) :
      bracketK K (φ f) (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = φ (bracketK K f (MvPolynomial.X i)) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
      (motive := fun f : MvPolynomial Var K =>
        bracketK K (φ f) (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)) = φ (bracketK K f (MvPolynomial.X i)))
      f ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro c
      simp
    · intro f g hf hg
      simp only [map_add, bracketK_add_left]
      exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hf hg
    · intro f j hf
      simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracketK_mul_left]
      rw [h, hf]
  intro f g
  refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
    (motive := fun g : MvPolynomial Var K =>
      bracketK K (φ f) (φ g) = φ (bracketK K f g))
    g ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro c
    simp
  · intro g h hg hh
    simp only [map_add, bracketK_add_right]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hg hh
  · intro g j hg
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracketK_mul_right]
    rw [hright, hg]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.poisson_iff_canonical
statement:
theorem poisson_iff_canonical (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K) :
    IsPoissonK K (MvPolynomial.aeval F) ↔
    ∀ i j : Var, bracketK K (F i) (F j) = MvPolynomial.C (canonicalMatrixK K i j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j
    have hi := h (MvPolynomial.X i) (MvPolynomial.X j)
    simpa [bracketK_X_X] using hi
  · intro h
    apply preserves_of_generators
    intro i j
    simpa [bracketK_X_X] using h i j

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.canonical_iff_matrix
statement:
theorem canonical_iff_matrix (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K) :
    (∀ i j : Var, bracketK K (F i) (F j) = MvPolynomial.C (canonicalMatrixK K i j)) ↔
    jacobian K F * (-omega) * (jacobian K F).transpose = -omega
proof:
:= by
  have heq (i j : Var) :
      MvPolynomial.C (canonicalMatrixK K i j) =
        (-omega : Matrix Var Var (MvPolynomial Var K)) i j := by
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [omega, canonicalMatrixK, canonicalMatrix]
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext i j
    rw [bracket_matrix, jacobian_pair, h, heq]
  · intro h i j
    rw [heq]
    have hi := congrFun (congrFun h i) j
    rwa [bracket_matrix, jacobian_pair] at hi

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.poisson_iff_symplectic
statement:
theorem poisson_iff_symplectic (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K) :
    IsPoissonK K (MvPolynomial.aeval F) ↔
    (jacobian K F).transpose * omega * jacobian K F = omega
proof:
:= by
  rw [poisson_iff_canonical, canonical_iff_matrix]
  exact conjugate_iff _ _ _ omega_mul_neg neg_mul_omega

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.det_of_poisson
statement:
theorem det_of_poisson (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K)
    (h : IsPoissonK K (MvPolynomial.aeval F)) : (jacobian K F).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_pair]
  simp only [jacobian_pair, (poisson_iff_canonical K F).mp h]
  norm_num [canonicalMatrixK, canonicalMatrix, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.bracket_skewK
statement:
theorem bracket_skewK (f g : MvPolynomial Var K) :
    bracketK K f g = -bracketK K g f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [bracketK]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.bracket_selfK
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_selfK (f : MvPolynomial Var K) : bracketK K f f = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [bracketK]
  ring

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.canonical_iff_six
statement:
theorem canonical_iff_six (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K) :
    (∀ i j : Var, bracketK K (F i) (F j) = MvPolynomial.C (canonicalMatrixK K i j)) ↔
    bracketK K (F 2) (F 0) = 1 ∧ bracketK K (F 3) (F 1) = 1 ∧
    bracketK K (F 0) (F 3) = 0 ∧ bracketK K (F 0) (F 1) = 0 ∧
    bracketK K (F 2) (F 3) = 0 ∧ bracketK K (F 2) (F 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [h]
    norm_num [canonicalMatrixK, canonicalMatrix, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
  · rintro ⟨h20, h31, h03, h01, h23, h21⟩
    have h02 : bracketK K (F 0) (F 2) = -1 := by rw [bracket_skewK, h20]
    have h13 : bracketK K (F 1) (F 3) = -1 := by rw [bracket_skewK, h31]
    have h30 : bracketK K (F 3) (F 0) = 0 := by rw [bracket_skewK, h03, neg_zero]
    have h10 : bracketK K (F 1) (F 0) = 0 := by rw [bracket_skewK, h01, neg_zero]
    have h32 : bracketK K (F 3) (F 2) = 0 := by rw [bracket_skewK, h23, neg_zero]
    have h12 : bracketK K (F 1) (F 2) = 0 := by rw [bracket_skewK, h21, neg_zero]
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [canonicalMatrixK, canonicalMatrix, h20, h31, h03, h01, h23, h21,
        h02, h13, h30, h10, h32, h12]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.poisson_iff_six
statement:
theorem poisson_iff_six (F : Var → MvPolynomial Var K) :
    IsPoissonK K (MvPolynomial.aeval F) ↔
    bracketK K (F 2) (F 0) = 1 ∧ bracketK K (F 3) (F 1) = 1 ∧
    bracketK K (F 0) (F 3) = 0 ∧ bracketK K (F 0) (F 1) = 0 ∧
    bracketK K (F 2) (F 3) = 0 ∧ bracketK K (F 2) (F 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [poisson_iff_canonical, canonical_iff_six]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_bracket_matrix
statement:
theorem output_bracket_matrix :
    jacobian K (outputK K) * (-omega) * (jacobian K (outputK K)).transpose = -omega
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [bracket_matrix, jacobian_pair, bracketK_outputK_outputK]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [omega, canonicalMatrixK, canonicalMatrix]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_det
statement: theorem output_det : (jacobian K (outputK K)).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_pair]
  simp only [jacobian_pair, bracketK_outputK_outputK]
  norm_num [canonicalMatrixK, canonicalMatrix, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.cons_val_three, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_symplectic
statement:
theorem output_symplectic :
    (jacobian K (outputK K)).transpose * omega * jacobian K (outputK K) = omega
proof:
:= by
  exact (conjugate_iff _ _ _ omega_mul_neg neg_mul_omega).mp (output_bracket_matrix K)

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_form_coefficients
statement:
theorem output_form_coefficients (i j : Var) :
    MvPolynomial.pderiv i (outputK K 0) * MvPolynomial.pderiv j (outputK K 2) -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv i (outputK K 2) * MvPolynomial.pderiv j (outputK K 0) +
      MvPolynomial.pderiv i (outputK K 1) * MvPolynomial.pderiv j (outputK K 3) -
      MvPolynomial.pderiv i (outputK K 3) * MvPolynomial.pderiv j (outputK K 1) =
      (omega : Matrix Var Var (MvPolynomial Var K)) i j
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (output_symplectic K) i) j
  rwa [form_entry] at h

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.criterion_complex
statement:
theorem criterion_complex (F : Var → PC) :
    IsPoissonC (MvPolynomial.aeval F) ↔
    (jacobian ℂ F).transpose * omega * jacobian ℂ F = omega
proof:
:=
  poisson_iff_symplectic ℂ F

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.six_criterion_complex
statement:
theorem six_criterion_complex (F : Var → PC) :
    IsPoissonC (MvPolynomial.aeval F) ↔
    bracketC (F 2) (F 0) = 1 ∧ bracketC (F 3) (F 1) = 1 ∧
    bracketC (F 0) (F 3) = 0 ∧ bracketC (F 0) (F 1) = 0 ∧
    bracketC (F 2) (F 3) = 0 ∧ bracketC (F 2) (F 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  poisson_iff_six ℂ F

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.det_of_poisson_complex
statement:
theorem det_of_poisson_complex (F : Var → PC)
    (h : IsPoissonC (MvPolynomial.aeval F)) : (jacobian ℂ F).det = 1
proof:
:=

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_det_complex

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_symplectic_complex

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.output_det_rational
statement: theorem output_det_rational : (jacobian ℚ output).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_pair]
  change bracket (output 2) (output 0) * bracket (output 3) (output 1) -
    bracket (output 0) (output 1) * bracket (output 2) (output 3) +
    bracket (output 0) (output 3) * bracket (output 2) (output 1) = 1
  simp [output]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Symplectic.main_complex
statement:
theorem main_complex :
    IsPoissonC PhiC ∧ ¬IsAlgAutomorphismC PhiC ∧
    (jacobian ℂ outputC).det = 1 ∧
    (∀ v : Var → ℂ, pointMapC PhiC v = targetC ↔
      v = point0C ∨ v = point1C ∨ v = complexPoint point2) ∧
    point0C ≠ point1C ∧ point0C ≠ complexPoint point2 ∧
    point1C ≠ complexPoint point2
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨PhiC_isPoisson, PhiC_not_automorphism, output_det_complex,
    Fiber.exact_fiber_complex, Fiber.fiber_points_distinct⟩

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.generators_rational
statement:
theorem generators_rational :
    bracket x y = x^3 ∧ bracket x beta = -3*x^2 ∧
      bracket y beta = -2 + 6*x*y + 3*x^2*beta
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v
    simp [bracket, polyDeriv, y, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z]
    ring
  constructor
  · apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v
    simp [bracket, polyDeriv, beta, B, a, rat, x, q, p, z]
  · apply MvPolynomial.funext
    intro v

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.add_left
statement: theorem add_left (f g h : CP K) : bracket3 K (f+g) h = bracket3 K f h + bracket3 K g h

statement:
theorem determinant_formula (f g : CP K) :
    bracket3 K f g = - Matrix.det (fun i j : Fin 3 => pderiv j (![r3 K,f,g] i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
  simp [bracket3, wedge, r3, map_ofNat, pderiv_two, pderiv_three]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.casimir

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.source_generators
statement:
theorem source_generators (i j : Fin 3) :
    bracketK K (coreSubstK K (X i)) (coreSubstK K (X j)) =
      coreSubstK K (bracket3 K (X i) (X j))
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : bracketK K (mapK K x) (mapK K y) = (mapK K x)^3 := by
    rw [bracket_mapK, generators_rational.1, map_pow]
  have hxb : bracketK K (mapK K x) (mapK K beta) = -3*(mapK K x)^2 := by
    rw [bracket_mapK, generators_rational.2.1]
    simp only [map_mul, map_neg, map_ofNat, map_pow]
  have hyb : bracketK K (mapK K y) (mapK K beta) =
      -2 + 6*(mapK K x)*(mapK K y) + 3*(mapK K x)^2*(mapK K beta) := by
    rw [bracket_mapK, generators_rational.2.2]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_neg, map_ofNat, map_pow]
  have hyx := Symplectic.bracket_skewK K (mapK K y) (mapK K x)
  have hbx := Symplectic.bracket_skewK K (mapK K beta) (mapK K x)
  have hby := Symplectic.bracket_skewK K (mapK K beta) (mapK K y)
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [coreSubstK, bracket3, wedge, hxy, hxb, hyb, hyx, hbx, hby,
      Symplectic.bracket_selfK, map_ofNat]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.source_bracket
statement:
theorem source_bracket (f g : CP K) :
    bracketK K (coreSubstK K f) (coreSubstK K g) = coreSubstK K (bracket3 K f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hg (i : Fin 3) (f : CP K) :
      bracketK K (coreSubstK K f) (coreSubstK K (X i)) = coreSubstK K (bracket3 K f (X i)) := by
    induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C c => simp [coreSubstK]
    | add f g hf hg => simp only [map_add, bracketK_add_left, add_left]; rw [hf,hg]
    | mul_X f j hf =>
      simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracketK_mul_left, mul_left]
      rw [source_generators, hf]
  induction g using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp [coreSubstK]
  | add g h hg hh => simp only [map_add, bracketK_add_right, add_right]; rw [hg,hh]
  | mul_X g j h =>
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracketK_mul_right, mul_right]
    rw [hg, h]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.source_bracket_determinant
statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [source_bracket, determinant_formula, map_neg]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Induced.source_casimir

name: RankTwoPoisson.Phi_preserves_right_generator
statement:
lemma Phi_preserves_right_generator (i : Var) (f : P) :
    bracket (Phi f) (Phi (X i)) = Phi (bracket f (X i))
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
    (motive := fun h : P =>
      bracket (Phi h) (Phi (X i)) = Phi (bracket h (X i)))
    f ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro c
    simp
  · intro f g hf hg
    simp only [map_add, bracket_add_left]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hf hg
  · intro f j hf
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracket_mul_left]
    rw [Phi_generator_bracket, hf]

name: RankTwoPoisson.Phi_isPoisson
statement: theorem Phi_isPoisson : IsPoisson Phi
proof:
:= by
  intro f g
  refine MvPolynomial.induction_on
    (motive := fun h : P =>
      bracket (Phi f) (Phi h) = Phi (bracket f h))
    g ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro c
    simp
  · intro g k hg hk
    simp only [map_add, bracket_add_right]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) hg hk
  · intro g j hg
    simp only [map_mul, map_add, bracket_mul_right]
    rw [Phi_preserves_right_generator, hg]
